title: Shortest path length in an unweighted graph
description: Implement shortest_path_length(graph, start, goal). graph is an undirected graph given as a dict mapping each node (str) to an iterable of neighbour nodes. Return the fewest edges on a path from start to goal, 0 when start equals goal, or -1 when no path exists.
invariants: A node that appears only as a neighbour is still traversable.
When start equals goal the answer is 0 even if that node is absent from the graph.
Two nodes in different components give -1.
